nodes.label: Integer amounts in currency minor unit
nodes.norm_label: integer amounts in currency minor unit
nodes.rationale: Amounts are stored as integers in the currency's minor unit (cents for USD, yen for JPY, fils for KWD) to avoid floating point errors. This implies a per-currency minor-unit exponent (USD=2, JPY=0, KWD=3) that import, storage, and reporting must all agree on.
